Today, my focus is building websites and online stores that help businesses show what they do and connect with customers. I stay close to every project, from the first conversation to launch.

Tell us what your website needs to do.

Share your business name, services, town and any existing website. Tell us whether you need customers to request quotes, make bookings or browse products. That helps us plan the pages and quote the actual work.

Can you build a website for a business in Osizweni or Madadeni?
+
A website people can actually use.

We start with the question a visitor needs answered: what does this business offer, and how can I contact them? Then we plan the pages, copy, images and enquiry path around that answer. A local service business may need a clear introduction and WhatsApp quote request. A shop may need product pages that make browsing and ordering easy.

For Legend Black Jesus, that meant a shop organised by clothing category, product pages with photographs, colour and size choices, and a bag that leads to a WhatsApp order. The brand's story and a gallery of people wearing the clothes each have their own place. Our work also includes the Snesenzo Security Group business website.
